khyed kyi dkyil 'khor lha rnams la// nyang stod khu le na thog gi /'gong po khu le lag dgu dang*// yam shud yul gyi btsan 'gong dmar// 'u yug rdo rje legs pa dang*// nags shod ku la gsang ba dang*// glags 'da'i ba glang dre'u'i sna ma// tsha ba sgang gi g.yu sgron ma// rtsang gi jo mo kha rag ma// mon gyi dun ting nag mo sogs// bod kyi yul 'dre sna tshogs snang*// khyed kyi dkyil 'khor mchod pa la// sman dang rakta gtor ma zhes// dang po bdud rtsi'i nang mchod 'bul// de rjes khrag gi yon chab dang*// de nas gtor ma de rjes la// phyi mchod rnams dang bstod pa byed// khungs ma'i rgyud gzhung thams cad las// thog mar chu bzhi nyer spyod lnga// rol mo ba dan rgyal mtshan gdugs// rgyal srid bdun dang grub pa brgyad// 'dod lnga mchod pa'i maṇḍal sogs// phyi yi mchod pa kun rdzogs nas// bstod pa'i rjes la nang mchod dang*// kun gyi mtha' la gtor ma mdzad// ces sogs rgyas par bshad do// de ltar de tsam du bshad pas ci zhig bya snyam na/ rgyal po dar mas bstan pa bsnubs pa'i 'og tu/ chos log 'phel ba'i rnam grangs 'di dang 'di yin no zhes/ khungs dag cing tshig nyung bar bsdus nas bshad pa 'di gsal bar mthong nas bris pa yin no// //dri ba bdun pa ni/ dpa' bo khyod kyi bstan pa ni// zhes sogs 'di ni su la bstod// rang re'i ston pa thugs rje can// nyid kyi bstod pa yin lags sam// zhes pa/ ma khol gyi mdzad pa'i sangs rgyas sum cu so lnga'i bstod pa dang*/ ston pa nyid kyi bstod pa brgya lnga bcu pa dang gnyis ka'i nang na snang ba las/ lung du drangs pa 'di gang yin zhes pa'o// dngos lan gdab pa ni/ lung khungs rting ma nas drangs pa yin snyam pa kun la snang yang*/ snga ma nas drangs par byas na 'byor ba yin te/ dpa' bo'i sde'i mtshan dang spel ba'i bstod par snang bas so//

//dri ba brgyad pa ni/ rig 'dzin sdom pa'i skabs shes pa'i// le'u'i mtshan yang mi 'byung ci// zhes pa'i bsam pa ni/ bstan bcos 'di'i rdzogs mtshams de nyid du don gyis thob pa yin nam snyam du sems pa dag mang ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis so// ma dris pa'i nyes pa ni/ kha cig theg pa rang sa na// zhes pa man chad ni/ rig 'dzin sdom pa kho na'i dbang du byas pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yang mi snang ste/ spyir chos log byung tshul bshad nas sun 'byin pa'i dbang du byas pa'i phyir dang*/ de man chod ni/ gong du bshad pa'i le'u thams cad kyi don bsdus nas 'chad par snang gi snyam pa'i dogs pa 'di skyes so// dngos lan ni/ ji skad du/ ci ste 'phags pa'i sar byed na// mdo rgyud kun dang 'gal bar 'gyur// zhes pa dang*/ kha cig theg pa rang sa na// zhes pa'i bar der/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i sdom pa'i skabs te le'u gsum pa'o// zhes pa zhig don gyis thob par snang ngo*// de ni rang dgar 'chad pa'o snyam na/ de lta bu'i le'u'i mtshan zhig bstan bcos 'dir 'byung rgyu ma yin na ni// don thob mtha' dag dang 'gal la/ sbyor rgyu yin na ni/ rdzogs mtshams su sbyar yang*/ rang dgar byas pa'i nyes pa nyid du mtshungs par 'gyur te/ bstan bcos mdzad pa pos dngos su ma sbyar ba'i phyir/ zhes bya ba'i gtan tshigs de ni 'di la yang yod pa'i phyir ro// de bas na bstan bcos 'di'i lus ni gnyis te/ sdom pa gsum gyi le'u so sor bshad pa dang*/ chos log sun 'byin snga ma rnams mdzad zin pa'i 'og tu/ chos kyi gnad 'khrul pa dag ji ltar byung ba'i tshul bshad nas/ de ji ltar sun 'byin pa'i thabs kyi lung rigs rnams go bde bar bshad pa'o// zhes bya ba 'di legs par grub pa'o// //smras pa// gzhan dang mi mnyam rnam dpyod kyi// stobs brgyas phyug pa'i gyad zung gis// des drangs lung brgya'i shing rta la// rab zhon 'bel ba'i gtam mang pos// rje btsun dgyes pa'i zhal gyi mdangs// 'char ka'i gos dmar gyis bklubs pa'i// dge mtshan gang 'dis thub bstan gyi// nyi ma lan brgyar 'char byed shog

/dpyod med rnam dpyod skyed pa dang*// dpyod chen som nyi sel byed pa// gang 'di rang don gtan tshigs te// phal cher lung gi rjes su 'brang*// gzhal bya'i gnas gnyis dngos stobs kyi// rigs pas ma sbyangs de srid du// lung gi byed pa 'jug min pa// de phyir thog mar rigs gzhung sbyongs// de 'dra de la 'bel gtam 'dis// gzhan don rjes su dpag byas nas// bsam bya'i don la tshan ma yis// drangs pa'i nges pa skyed par 'gyur// gang gis rnam brtags dri ba 'di'i// bsam pa ji bzhin mi shes na// slar yang 'dri por dri byos zhes// sngar lung bstan nas deng 'dir sbyar// gang 'di'i rjes 'jug dad pa yi// rjes 'brang lung brgya blta ba dang*// rang blos dpyod pa'i mthu bral ba// de kun rnam dpyod rgyas phyir bsngo// deng 'dir dgos don bsdus don dang*// rgal lan sbyar nas 'chad byed pa// gang de gsung rab mtha' dag la// blta ba'i mig can yin snyam byed// de nas mkhas pa'i gzhung lugs mchog /dad pa'i rgyal mtshan rtser mchod nas// dpyod can re ba'i snod mang po// 'gengs byed 'dod rgu'i char chen phebs// e ma dri ba'i bsam pa ni// log pa'i blo yis gzhan zhig tu// drangs nas de sun 'byin pa yi// ngal bas 'di lan ji ltar ldon// dri bas chos 'di sun phyung zhes// dril chen phyogs mthar sgrog byed pa// gang de'i blo mtsho'i gting zab na// 'dod pa'i rin chen gzhan med dam// gang yang chos 'dir bsams nges na// dri ba'i bsam pa 'di long la// 'dir 'byung min pa'i lan gzhan zhig /'debs byed yod na rjes yi rang*// legs bshad khrus kyi dag byed mkhan de yis// thub bstan yid bzhin rin chen ma nyams pa// kun dga'i rgyal mtshan rtse mor len mdzad pa'i// dpal ldan phrin las bzang por 'di 'bul gyi// rig gnas mdo sngags chu gter bcud chen po// rnam dpyod hub thebs gcig gis zhal gyi sgor// gang drangs bstan 'dzin yongs 'du'i dpag bsam la// nyer sim byed po'i phyag gis 'di long shig

/ces sdom pa gsum gyi rab tu dbye ba zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos las brtsams pa'i 'bel gtam rnam par nges pa legs bshad gser gyi thur ma zhes bya ba 'di ni/ ma byon pa'i sangs rgyas gsum pa shākya shrī bha dra'i chos kyi seng ge'i khri la/ mang du gsan pa'i zhabs zung nges par bsti zhing*/ rnam dpyod kyi mgrin pa mngon par mtho ba/ nyi ma rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal mnga' nas dang*/ rgyal sras sems dpa' chen po bsod nams grags pa'i rgyal tshab/ ratna ā kā ra'i gsung gis nye bar bskul ba la brten nas/ khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bor bzhugs pas mtshan brjod par dka' ba/ don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te/ rje btsun dam pa ā nanda bha dra'i zhabs kyi rdul phreng rnyog pa med pa'i spyi bos nye bar blangs nas/ sdom pa gsum gyi bka' drin gyis skal ba bzang por bgyis pa/ dpal shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blos/ 'phar ba zhes pa lcags mo glang gi lo/ chu stod kyis nya yongs su gang ba'i nyin/ g.yas ru rtsang gi sa'i thig le thub bstan gser mdog can zhes bya ba'i dben gnas su yongs su rdzogs par grub pa'i yi ge pa ni chos kyi rgyal mtshan no// dpal phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan srid rtse'i bar du sgreng ba la mkhas par gyur cig/ //swa sti si ddhaṃ/ bde chen nyin mor byed pa'i mdangs gsal ba// chos dbyings nam mkha'i dbus su rol rtsed mkhan// spros ba'i sprin tshogs rnam dral zung 'jug sku// rigs brgya'i mgon du shar la phyag 'tshal lo// nges don 'jug pa rnam bcu'i gar rtse yang*// drang don nor lha'i bu dang pad dkar mig /rig byed dran pos ma thob ro brgya pas// 'gro kun bdud rtsir mdzad la phyag bgyi'o// dngos kun rang bzhin brjod pa kun gyi rgyu// rmongs rnams sel byed brjod bral ye shes blo// gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa'i dri ma drungs phyung ba// gzhi lam 'bras bu'i 'jam dbyangs e ma mtshar// gang khyod zab gsal yid 'phrog gzhon nu'i sku// la lar dkyil 'khor 'khor lo sgyur ba'i gzugs// gzhan du tshangs dbang grub pa'i tshul bzung nas// rig gnas rnam brgya ston la 'grus mi lhod// skabs der kun dga'i 'dzum phreng 'char ka'i mdangs// shar phyogs sa skyong ri bo'i cod paṇa gyi// rgyal mtshan rtse mor mchod 'os bstan pa'i dpal// phrin las bzang po'i nyi ma 'di na shar// kun khyab grags pa'i gsung gi ba dan ni// 'phags yul dam chos dga' ba'i tshal du brkyang*// rgyal rnga brdungs pa'i paṇa chen mang pos kyang*// khyod zhabs ya mtshan bstod pa'i phreng bas bsngags// dus der bdud rtsis sbags pa'i dug can mtsho// gangs can khor yug dbus su 'phyur ba na// lung rigs mkha' lding kha sgor rnam dpyod kyi// ro 'dzin rtse mor blangs pa'i sbrang rtsi ni// 'chad rtsom dpag bsam yongs 'du'i dpung par blangs// de yi ris na rnam dpyod mdangs gsal zhing*// nges don cha shas gang ba'i blo bzang po// rig pa'i gnas brgyar 'phro ba'i 'od dkar can// bde 'byung gtsug rgyan gnyis pa deng 'dir shar// drag po'i cod paṇa ma nyams shing*// 'chi med lam las ma lhung bar// rab dkar ku muta bzhad pa'i gnyen// gangs can ljongs su rgyu ba yang*// tsha zer lam las rgyang srings pa// thun mtshams ri bo'i rtser 'dzegs nas// rgyu skar phreng ldan sngo sangs ma'i// bzhin mdangs ri mo ma nyams pa// gcig char 'char byed dngul dkar gyi// thig le lha yi lam chen por// gegs byed med par rgyu ba ni// mtshan mo'i nyi ma gnyis pa bzhin// sdom gsum bstan 'chos mkhas rmongs mtha' dag gi

/blo la bshin phyir don bzang lugs brgya pa// tshig zur phyin pa'i sbyor bas ma bcings par// 'jam po'i ngag gis lhod par 'doms pa ni// gzhung brgya'i pha rol son pa'i blo bzang gis// tshad ldan mkhas pa'i gzhung gi lam srang du// rigs pas drangs te tshig la mi rton par// don rton byed pos 'khrul par mi 'chad mod// gzhung 'dir blo mi phyogs dang 'dud byed kyang*// nyes bshad zegs phreng bsdud pa'i blo ngan dag /chos min gtam gyis gzhung 'chad dor bya'i phyir// ngo mtshar legs bshad 'bel gtam 'di byas so// gzhung chen 'chad rnams rgal lan lugs brgya yi// shing rta'i khri la blangs nas 'chad byos zhes// byams pa'i gzhung bzhin dbyig gnyen gyis 'doms pa// phyogs glang grags pa'i ring lugs 'di na dge /dpal ldan legs bshad smra ba'i sgo brgya pa// gang 'di'i do zlar lhags pa'i rnam bshad gzhan// phal cher ldongs shing la la ldab ldib can// gzhan dag byis pa'i rol rtsed lhur len byed// rang gi mdun sar nyi ma ji bzhin du// mngon rlom dregs pas rgyal ba'i rgyu skar 'ga'// phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i zer phreng gis// zos shing 'thungs pas mun par byas min nam// sdom gsum bstan bcos yid bzhin rgya mtsho yi// pha rol blta 'dod gzhan smod grur zhugs nas// rang bstod skya ba thogs pa'i mnyan pa dag /mang thos gru gzhan slar bzung dgos min nam// tshad thub 'grel chen bzhi dang gzhung nyid du// tshig zur ji bzhin ma phyin 'dir dpyod kyi// tshangs par rlom pa'i col chung bgrang yas dag /dpyad yul min phyir bde bar gnyid byos shig /rnyed bkur 'dris 'khren 'ga' dang dbyen dpyo ba'i// rtog dpyod lan brgyar btang nas ya rabs kyi// tshogs par dbyung bya min pa'i tshig gi mda'// dug can 'phen des de nyid sreg min nam// rang gzhung sgrub dang gzhan gzhung sun 'byin pa'i// zab rgyas lung rigs sbyor ba'i mthu grub 'ga'// gsong por smra dang la lar bstings pa'i tshig

/brjod mkhas gtan tshigs rig rnams smra ba'i rgyan// kwa ye rab dkar seng chen mgo 'phangs gyen du bteg 'dra'i sa 'dzin dkar po'i ngos kyi 'jam dbyangs chos kyi gdung 'dzin rje btsun gang gang gi /gzhung lugs 'dzin pa'i mngon rlom can 'ga' dregs pas bsnyems mod de de'i ring lugs sgrub byed lung dang rigs pa'i rtags kyi tsher ma 'byin nus du// de'i gzhan phyogs la sdang byed mkhan rnams rang gzhung snying rtsa 'phrog byed sde pa'i gzhung mang blta'am rtog gam rigs par sun 'byin nus pa'ang su// sdang 'dod 'di ni lta dang grub mtha'i 'dzin skyong zol gyis 'ongs mod 'khor dang rnyed bkur nges par sem byed min nam gzu bo'i blos rtogs shig /rgyan drug gzhung lugs blta ba'i legs bshad kyi// smin legs rnam drug ldan pa'i rnam dpyod 'dis// chen po'i yul 'dzin glang po'i gdong can gyi// mngon rlom mche ba'i rno ngar bcag snyam byed// mang thos lung dang rigs pa'i khyu mchog tu// bsngags 'os glang chen bye bas brtsad gyur kyang*// 'jigs med gangs ri'i ngos la gnas 'cha' ba'i// ngo mtshar spobs pa'i seng chen 'di 'khrungs so// gzhung 'dir khas len byed gzhan mang po yis// dris lan gnas gcig tsam la'ang rdeng thob bam// dpyod ldan yod na slar yang dris shig dang*// gang 'dis gtan la ma phebs lhag ma gang*// rab dkar cha shas rdzogs pa'i zla ba ni// ther 'bum grangs mnyam cig char shar ba na// de re re la brtse chen gzugs kyi nyams// 'bri mkhas brgya byin lag pa'i 'phrul bzhin du// dkar 'jam shog bu'i ngos la legs bshad kyi// lang tsho ma nyams 'char mkhas bdag po'i rkyen// rgyu tshogs ma tshang med par sbyor byed po// tshogs gnyis yan lag bzhi pa'i dpung tshogs can// mnga' ris nor 'dzin skyong bar bkra shis kyi// bgrang yas me tog gsar pa'i char chen po// sa gsum skye rgu'i mgon dang rgyal ba'i sras// dam can rgya mtshos nges par bstsal de yin// gang 'di'i rnam dpyod sa skyong gzhan mang po'i// blo gros byis pa'i bzlos gar ltar byed cig

/rgyal phran la la'i phrin las chu shing gi /lo 'bras rgyas pa'i sdong po ltar bgrangs nas// bka' bstsal dang du nod pa'i khor yug khongs// phan bder bgyis pa'i stabs la su yis 'gran// thub bstan 'bum phrag bzhi pa'i gling chen po// sgrin 'grus gyad kyis bslad pa'i ya mtshan ni// lhun stug rin chen las sbyangs gtsug lag khang*// mang pos mi sgrun bsod nams pho brang na// yid 'phrog bkod legs brtsegs pa'i khri 'phang la// thub chen mig stong ldan pa lha yi bla// dbang sngon lang tshor zhugs pa'i gser phreng gi /nyi 'od rab 'bar bka' 'gyur 'dzam gling rgyan// mchod rdzas rol mtsho'i phreng ba mtshar du dngar// 'di dag lha yi bzo bo las kun pa'i// ngo mtshar sgyu ma'i rnam rol bgrang yas kyi// sgyu 'phrul mkhan de'i rnam 'phrul min nam ci// mchog tshogs 'dus pa'i gling chen bcu gnyis por// mthun rkyen phyi yi mtsho chen nges par 'dud// phyi rgol blta zer bsrung ba'i rta gdong me// pha rol ri gzhan mthon pos der mi non// tshu rol nang gi rgya mtsho nges mi 'khrug /steng nas gdung byed zhugs kyis mi 'gong pa'i// khor yug ri bo'i khongs de skyabs gsum gyis// phyogs las rnam rgyal sa 'dzin lhun po bzhin// gang gi grags pa'i me long du// legs byas ri mo ma nyams pa// gang shar nam yang gsub med de// sngon gyi byed po mthu grub pas// byas pa min nam snyan grags kyi// utpal phyogs kyi bu mo yi// rna bar brgyud mkhas rnam dpyod kyi// lag pas slar yang chos dang ni// srid kyi rgyal mtshan phreng mdzes dang*// phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i rnga// 'dzin zhing khor yug yangs pa'i sa// skyong zhing bsrung ba nyid gyur cig /de nas srid dang zhi ba yi// dgra tshogs kun las rnam rgyal ba'i// chos kyi rgyal po rdzogs sangs rgyas// don gnyis mthar phyin de brnyes shog

/kyai ho 'di na kha cig rtswa rtse'i tshad kyis bcal ba'i legs bshad kyis khengs gti mug ljon phreng rgyas ba'i nags na mkha' lding lta bur rol zhing 'gying*// gzhan ni phrag dog zas kyis lto khengs dug can mtsho nas brgyud pa'i myos byed kyis myos dran nyams bzhin du mang por smra ba rab 'phyo byed// legs bshad klung brgyas phyogs bcur drangs kyang mi zad lung rigs man ngag char chen bsdud pa'i mtsho chen 'di dang de 'dzin byed po'i klu dbang yang*// thub bstan gser gyi nor 'dzin sgeg mo'i 'phang par ring 'tsho bstan bsrung dam can rgya mtshos bsrung zhing skyong la rtag tu brtson pa lhur longs shig /rgyal ba kun dngos khyab bdag rdo rje 'dzin// slu med dkon mchog gsum dang bsrungs ma'i tshogs// phan par dgongs pa'i bkra shis dge legs kyis// skye rgu'i mgon la bsrung zhing skyob mdzad shog /gang 'di'i zhus dag mnga' ris pa// chos kyi rgyal mtshan snyan ngag mkhan// yi ger 'bri po stag tshang pa// tshul khrims 'phel yin rkos byed mkhan// ra sa 'phrul gyi chos bzang dang*// chos skyong bzang po sga gdong pa// chos dpal ldan sogs mched lnga pos// thub bstan gser mdog can gyi grwar// myur mgyogs bar chad med par grub// dge des mtshan nas smos pa kun// dus kyi dgra las rnam rgyal nas// ma rnams don du rdzogs sangs rgyas// chos kyi rgyal po de thob shog /sa skyong sras dang de yum bcas// pha rol 'tshe ba med pa dang*// mnga' 'bangs mtsho bzhin gang ba dang*// dbu rmog gong nas gong btsan shog /mdzes byed ces pa chu mo yos kyi lo'i cho 'phrul chen po'i yar ngo la dbu btsugs nas/ lha las babs pa'i dus khyad par can la grub pa'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/
skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
